name: view_duel_seawall_and_sent_bottles
description: The duel's views in the world (contract-m7.md §3) on Undertow's own rules against the caretaker: in window 2 I cork the Drift's first pack and the caretaker corks its own, which the tray shows as my bottle (with its pack) and the rival's corked shape (its tier only). In wave 2 both are uncorked: each pack wells up at the Welling of the road it walks (a ring in the sending seat's colour), and every creep it sent carries the small corked bottle that glints over it, the rival's on my road and mine on the rival's (V shows them). Then, with eight lives lost for two charges, F bursts a Seawall: surf rises round my Holdfast as wide as the rules' 3 m and is gone within a second and a half. Last, the rival's Holdfast falls and the results plate says so in the duel's words.

steps.msg: the caretaker rival's gold, so it corks in window 2: tier I costs 45 since the sends' pass, more than its fifth of what it holds there

steps.assert: Game.my_bottles()[0]['pack'] == Game.sim.drift_offer()[0] and Game.rival_bottles().size() == 1 and node('DriftTray').rivals_shown() == [{'tier': 'I', 'pack': '', 'candidates': Game.rival_bottles()[0]['candidates']}]
steps.msg: my pack corked, and the caretaker's bottle by its tier
an uncorked pack wells up with a ring in its sender's colour
every sent creep carries its bottle
the rival's on my road, mine on the rival's
the painted corked bottle, not a stand-in
the surf rises round my Holdfast, out to 3 m
the results in the duel's words
